shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊，身后墙上挂着空白的岗位牌，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory building corridor beside a blank role plaque on the wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天认识一个岗位：生物安全员。

shots.scene: 欣欣手举一个盾牌图标和一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a shield icon in one hand and a person outline icon in the other.
shots.narration: 他管的事，比你想的多得多。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一叠空白表格皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a stack of blank forms on his desk.
shots.narration: 阿杰嘀咕：又要填安全表格。

shots.scene: 阿杰摊手，表情不耐烦
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs with an impatient look.
shots.narration: 这些事，不就是浪费时间吗？

shots.scene: 小研从门口探头，好奇地问
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans in from the doorway with a curious expression.
shots.narration: 小研问：那生物安全员管什么？

shots.scene: 王老师胸前别着空白工牌走进来，微笑
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in wearing a blank badge and smiles.
shots.narration: 王老师正是单位的生物安全员。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白白板前画了一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator draws a big question mark on a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 她说：咱们从头讲讲。

shots.scene: 一个由设备、规程、人三块拼图组成的圆，人形那块发光
shots.prompt_en: A circle made of three puzzle pieces with equipment, document and person icons; the person piece glows. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全体系里，最关键的是人。

shots.scene: 王老师把空白的单位政策文件举起
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank policy document with a building icon.
shots.narration: 安全员要读懂单位的安全政策，

shots.scene: 王老师把文件贴到实验室门边，人们走过
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator pins the blank policy document beside a laboratory door as the older man walks past.
shots.narration: 并把它真正落到每间实验室。

shots.scene: 四个空白卡片排成一行，各有图标：名单、书本、手册、心形
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row with icons: a checklist, a book, a manual and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课有四个目标。

shots.scene: 第三张手册卡片放大，翻开第一章
shots.prompt_en: The manual card enlarges and opens to its first chapter, which shows only a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 讲清职责，写进安全手册。

shots.scene: 心形卡片发光，周围出现几个小人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The heart card glows and small person icons gather around it. No people.
shots.narration: 最后，把安全变成大家的习惯。

shots.scene: 四个红色圆环绕着中间的大圆
shots.prompt_en: Four red circles orbit a large central circle, each with an icon: a footprint, a lightbulb, a heart and a flag. No people.
shots.narration: 文化，是一群人共同的东西：

shots.scene: 小研进门不假思索地换上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters the lab and puts on a lab coat without hesitation.
shots.narration: 大家不用想，就会这么做。

shots.scene: 多人排队洗手的轮廓图标
shots.prompt_en: Outline icons of several people washing hands in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是安全文化的样子。

shots.section_title: 文化靠沟通和模仿传下去
shots.scene: 三角形三个角：对话气泡、两个相同动作的人、大脑图标
shots.prompt_en: A triangle with three corner icons: speech bubbles, two figures copying the same gesture, and a brain. No people.
shots.narration: 文化靠三样东西传下去：
overlay: 文化靠沟通和模仿传下去

shots.section_title: 文化靠沟通和模仿传下去
shots.scene: 老周戴好护目镜，阿杰在旁边学着戴
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts on safety goggles and the young male student copies him beside him.
shots.narration: 老人怎么做，新人就跟着学。

shots.section_title: 文化靠沟通和模仿传下去
shots.scene: 王老师在白板前思考，旁边有灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands thinking in front of a blank whiteboard with a lightbulb icon above her head.
shots.narration: 安全员要想：怎么建、怎么传、怎么保持。

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜子整理自己的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot adjusts its safety goggles in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 改变，先从自己做起。

shots.scene: 一个人发光，周围的人陆续亮起
shots.prompt_en: One glowing person icon, then the surrounding person icons light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 不用等别人先动。

shots.scene: 被锁链拖着走的人形图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person icon being dragged along by a chain toward a law book icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: “法律逼我，我才遵守”，不够。

shots.scene: 空白规则本旁画着规格、政策、标准、法律四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank rule book surrounded by four icons: a ruler, a document, a medal and a gavel. No people.
shots.narration: 合规，就是遵从规则、标准和法律。

shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰一起看规程，阿杰点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student read a blank procedure together; he nods.
shots.narration: 知道为什么，才会主动去做。

shots.scene: 一摞空白文件，各有图标：地球、国旗轮廓、书、天平、烧瓶、勋章
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank documents with icons: a globe, a flag outline, a book, a balance scale, a flask and a medal. No people.
shots.narration: 单位要遵从的依据很多：

shots.scene: 地球图标在背景，国旗轮廓图标在前面放大
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon in the background with a large flag outline icon in front. No people.
shots.narration: 国际法、国家法律，都在其中。

shots.section_title: 意识、行动、反省，循环改进
shots.scene: 蓝、绿、红三个方块，箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Three blocks in blue, green and red connected by downward arrows, with an eye icon, a hand icon and a mirror icon. No people.
shots.narration: 合规分三步：
overlay: 意识、行动、反省，循环改进

shots.section_title: 意识、行动、反省，循环改进
shots.scene: 四个方块组成循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: Four blocks forming a circular arrow loop with a pencil, a hand, a magnifier and a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 计划、执行、检查、改进，一圈圈转。

shots.section_title: 意识、行动、反省，循环改进
shots.scene: 台阶图标逐级上升
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon rising step by step with a green arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 每转一圈，安全就更进一步。

shots.scene: 王老师站在空白地图前，手指起点
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a blank route map and points to a starting dot.
shots.narration: 新安全员，从哪下手？

shots.scene: 四个图标：文件、法槌、握手、人群
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a policy document, a gavel, a handshake and a group of people. No people.
shots.narration: 政策、法律、社会责任，还有人。

shots.scene: 空白政策文件被放进单位大楼图标里
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy document slides into a building icon labelled only with a star. No people.
shots.narration: 安全政策要写进单位的发展目标。

shots.scene: 王老师与几位老师握手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes hands with the older man while the female graduate student smiles nearby.
shots.narration: 找到愿意带头的人，最关键。

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 一本空白法规书翻到新页，旁边一张空白证书
shots.prompt_en: A blank law book opens to a new page next to a blank certificate with a ribbon icon. No people.
shots.narration: 法规修订：单位须聘持证安全员。
overlay: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白聘书走进一栋大楼
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks into a building holding a blank appointment letter.
shots.narration: 王老师新到一家单位任职，

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 王老师面对摇头的阿杰和皱眉的老周
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator faces the young male student shaking his head and the older man frowning.
shots.narration: 这里没做过风险管理，都嫌负担。

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 钱袋图标和沙漏图标被画上问号
shots.prompt_en: A money bag icon and an hourglass icon, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 领导嫌花钱，研究人员嫌添活。

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 三层金字塔，从上到下：灯泡、对话、齿轮
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid with a lightbulb on top, speech bubbles in the middle and a gear at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 先让大家明白，再多沟通，然后落实。

shots.section_title: 推动变革：意识、沟通、实施
shots.scene: 阿杰终于点头，拿起空白表格认真填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finally nods and carefully fills in a blank form.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：原来这是在保护我。

shots.scene: 王老师双手托起一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a shield icon in both hands.
shots.narration: 责任，首先是分内要做的事。

shots.scene: 天平图标一端放着空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a blank logbook on one side. No people.
shots.narration: 做了什么，要负得起责。

shots.scene: 王老师抬手示意暂停，面前的实验台停止
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator raises her hand to signal stop at a laboratory bench.
shots.narration: 必要时，还要能独立拍板叫停。

shots.section_title: 懂微生物和细胞生物学
shots.scene: 显微镜和细胞图标
shots.prompt_en: A microscope icon next to a simple cell diagram icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员要懂微生物和细胞生物学。
overlay: 懂微生物和细胞生物学

shots.section_title: 懂微生物和细胞生物学
shots.scene: 老周拿着空白申请书走来，王老师接过
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank project application to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 有老师想在普通实验室培养病原体。

shots.section_title: 懂微生物和细胞生物学
shots.scene: 王老师面前浮现几个问号卡片：微生物图标、等级图标、房间图标、印章
shots.prompt_en: Question cards float before the safety administrator: a microbe icon, a level icon, a room icon and a stamp icon.
shots.narration: 安全员先问：是什么、几类、在哪做？

shots.section_title: 懂微生物和细胞生物学
shots.scene: 普通实验室门口画着停止手势
shots.prompt_en: A general laboratory door with a stop hand icon in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 这些问题，都要先问清楚。

shots.section_title: 懂基因工程和生物技术
shots.scene: 双螺旋和试管图标
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon next to a test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 也要懂基因工程和生物技术。
overlay: 懂基因工程和生物技术

shots.section_title: 懂基因工程和生物技术
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白课题方案找王老师
shots.prompt_en: The young male student brings a blank research plan to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 研究生想在昆虫细胞里表达病原抗原，

shots.section_title: 懂基因工程和生物技术
shots.scene: 空白评估表和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A blank assessment form under a magnifier icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险该怎么评估？

shots.section_title: 生物因子的风险与分类
shots.scene: 微生物图标旁边还有化学瓶、锐器、电插头图标
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon surrounded by a chemical bottle, a needle and an electric plug icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险之外，还有化学、锐器、用电。
overlay: 生物因子的风险与分类

shots.section_title: 生物因子的风险与分类
shots.scene: 空白卡片上一个微生物图标和一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a microbe icon and a large question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 关键问题：什么是生物因子？

shots.section_title: 生物因子的风险与分类
shots.scene: 王老师在空白板前把几张卡片分成几堆，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sorts blank cards into several piles on a board, with a question mark beside her.
shots.narration: 又该怎样给它们分类？

shots.section_title: 判断是不是实验室感染
shots.scene: 十个人形图标中有六个变红
shots.prompt_en: Ten person outline icons; six of them turn red. No people.
shots.narration: 同一组十个人，六人确诊感染。
overlay: 判断是不是实验室感染

shots.section_title: 判断是不是实验室感染
shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白考勤记录和健康记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank attendance log and a blank health record.
shots.narration: 是实验室里感染的，还是之前就有？

shots.section_title: 判断是不是实验室感染
shots.scene: 时间轴图标，进组前和进组后两段
shots.prompt_en: A timeline icon split into before-joining and after-joining sections. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员要会调查，找出原因。

shots.scene: 王老师和一位穿白大褂的校医（用医疗十字图标代表）握手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes hands beside a medical cross icon at a clinic door.
shots.narration: 安全员要和职业健康部门合作。

shots.scene: 体检表和疫苗图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank health check form and a vaccine vial icon. No people.
shots.narration: 做好预防和健康监测。

shots.scene: 实验人员健康的笑脸图标
shots.prompt_en: Smiling person icons with a green heart. No people.
shots.narration: 让每个实验人员都健康。

shots.scene: 疲惫的阿杰打哈欠，旁边有错误图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns tiredly at his bench with a small warning icon nearby.
shots.narration: 人会累，会走神，会犯错。

shots.scene: 两种错误图标：手滑和故意绕道
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a slipping hand and a person taking a forbidden shortcut, both with warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 有无心之失，也有故意违规。

shots.scene: 王老师耐心地与阿杰交谈
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks patiently with the young male student.
shots.narration: 安全员要会引导，改变行为和观念。

shots.section_title: 懂防护屏障和它的局限
shots.scene: 两层屏障图标：内层设备，外层房间
shots.prompt_en: Two nested barrier icons: an inner cabinet barrier and an outer room barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 防护屏障有好几类。
overlay: 懂防护屏障和它的局限

shots.section_title: 懂防护屏障和它的局限
shots.scene: 屏障上有一道裂缝的图标
shots.prompt_en: A barrier icon with a small crack and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 每道屏障都有局限，不能全靠它。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a bench holding a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 具体工作，要先做风险评估。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层，每层一个图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid of five layers with icons: removing, swapping, a cabinet, a document and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 按控制层级，选择措施。

shots.scene: 王老师向老周讲解空白评估结论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank assessment result to the older man.
shots.narration: 再把结论讲给负责人和课题组。

shots.scene: 实验楼与外面的树木河流，中间一道绿色屏障
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory building with trees and a river outside, separated by a green barrier line. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员也要保护环境。

shots.scene: 微生物图标想穿过屏障，被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon trying to pass through the green barrier and being blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 防止生物材料逃逸到外面。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着电话图标，旁边有专家头像图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a phone next to an expert icon with a graduation cap.
shots.narration: 拿不准的事，及时请专家。

shots.scene: 老李和王老师一起看空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator study blank technical drawings together.
shots.narration: 安全员要看得懂设施图纸，

shots.scene: 通风管道和气流箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A ventilation duct icon with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 懂通风空调这些系统。

shots.scene: 建设、调试、维护、退役四个阶段图标
shots.prompt_en: Four stage icons in a row: a crane, a check meter, a wrench and a closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 从建造到退役，每步都有安全问题。

shots.scene: 一张会议桌，王老师、老李和一位穿西装的人（用公文包图标代替）
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer sit at a meeting table with a briefcase icon representing consultants.
shots.narration: 单位要建三级生物安全动物设施。

shots.scene: 王老师举起空白问题清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank list of questions.
shots.narration: 安全员代表单位，向设计方提问。

shots.scene: 王老师与主管部门（用政府大楼图标代表）沟通
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks beside a government building icon.
shots.narration: 还要与地方主管部门沟通。

shots.scene: 王老师看着问题清单托腮思考，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator looks at the blank question list thoughtfully, chin on hand, with a question mark beside her.
shots.narration: 这些都是安全员的职责吗？

shots.scene: 六个图标围成圈：挑选、操作手、安装扳手、对勾、证书、维修工具
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a circle: a shopping cart, a hand, a wrench, a check mark, a certificate and a toolbox. No people.
shots.narration: 设备从选到修，都要把关。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李站在一台新生物安全柜前
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer stand in front of a new biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 比如采购一台生物安全柜，

shots.scene: 安全柜贴着空白检测合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with a blank certification tag and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选型、安装、检测认证，一样不少。

shots.scene: 小研规范操作，台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works neatly at a tidy bench wearing gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 良好微生物操作，是安全的基本功。

shots.scene: 工作流程箭头从清洁区到污染区
shots.prompt_en: A workflow arrow running from a clean area to a dirty area on a bench plan. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员要指导大家，理顺工作流程。

shots.scene: 手套、实验服、护目镜、口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, a lab coat, safety goggles and a mask. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品，要按具体工作来选。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴口罩皱眉，王老师帮他调整
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns in a mask and the safety administrator helps adjust its fit.
shots.narration: 用起来有问题，要及时解决。

shots.scene: 消毒液瓶、擦拭布和高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a disinfectant bottle, a wiping cloth and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒、去污、灭菌，方法不同。

shots.scene: 效果对比的对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three method icons with green check marks of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员要知道哪种管用、怎么用对。

shots.scene: 带生物危害标志的废物袋和流程箭头
shots.prompt_en: A waste bag with a biohazard warning sign and a process arrow toward an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物，要有完整的管理方案，

shots.scene: 灭菌指示卡变色的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank sterilization indicator card changing color with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 处理效果还要验证。

shots.scene: 空白应急预案本和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan booklet and a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要有应急预案，

shots.scene: 应急物资箱和洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: An emergency spill kit box and an eyewash sign. No people.
shots.narration: 备好物资，知道出事怎么办。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着放大镜和空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a magnifier and a blank incident report.
shots.narration: 出了事故，要会调查。

shots.scene: 事件链图标，从原因到结果
shots.prompt_en: A chain of linked icons from cause to result, with the first link highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 找到根本原因，防止再发生。

shots.scene: 多个齿轮咬合转动
shots.prompt_en: Several interlocking gears turning together, labelled only with icons. No people.
shots.narration: 安全计划由很多部分组成。

shots.scene: 王老师把齿轮装进机器，机器开始运转
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator fits a gear into a machine icon that starts turning.
shots.narration: 安全员要让它们一起转起来。

shots.section_title: 培训：按需设计，验证效果
shots.scene: 王老师给一群学生上课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group including the young male student in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 培训，先看大家需要什么。
overlay: 培训：按需设计，验证效果

shots.section_title: 培训：按需设计，验证效果
shots.scene: 三组不同的人形图标，配不同的书本
shots.prompt_en: Three groups of person icons, each matched with a different book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不同的人，培训内容不一样。

shots.section_title: 培训：按需设计，验证效果
shots.scene: 空白考核卷上打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz paper with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 培训完要考核，定期再培训。

shots.scene: 王老师在会议上讲话，大家认真听
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator speaks at a meeting while the older man and the female graduate student listen.
shots.narration: 安全员要把话说清楚。

shots.scene: 管理层、实验人员、外单位三组图标
shots.prompt_en: Three groups of icons: a manager with a tie, lab workers in coats, and visitors with badges. No people.
shots.narration: 对领导、对同事、对外单位都一样。

shots.scene: 心形和对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon next to speech bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 讲道理，也要体谅人。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks into a laboratory holding a blank inspection checklist.
shots.narration: 定期审核和检查，

shots.scene: 检查表上有对勾也有叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with some green check marks and one red X. No people.
shots.narration: 找出缺陷和不符合的地方，

shots.scene: 向上的改进箭头
shots.prompt_en: An upward arrow with a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再提出改进办法。

shots.scene: 三层包装箱图标和运输车
shots.prompt_en: A triple packaging box icon next to a delivery van icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物材料运输和进出口，规矩很多。

shots.scene: 包装箱上贴着生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A sealed package with a biohazard warning sign and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 包装、标识、运输方式都要合规。

shots.scene: 一摞法规文件，旁边小地球
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank law documents with a flag outline icon, next to a small globe. No people.
shots.narration: 要熟悉国内外的法规和标准。

shots.scene: 封面空白的四本书：法、标准、指南、公约图标
shots.prompt_en: Four blank books with a gavel icon, a ruler icon, a document icon and a handshake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 法规、标准、指南和公约，都要合规。

shots.scene: 三本带地球图标的书并排
shots.prompt_en: Three blank books side by side, each with a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国际指南：世卫手册、欧洲标准、美国手册。

shots.scene: 天平和心形图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a heart on one side and a microscope on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 做科研，还要讲生物伦理。

shots.scene: 空白行为准则本
shots.prompt_en: A blank code of conduct booklet with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守相关法规和行为准则。

shots.section_title: 特殊高风险领域要多学
shots.scene: 一圈图标：小鼠、植物、昆虫、大罐、医院十字、双螺旋
shots.prompt_en: A ring of icons: a mouse, a plant, an insect, a large tank, a hospital cross and a double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 动物、植物、昆虫、临床检验……
overlay: 特殊高风险领域要多学

shots.section_title: 特殊高风险领域要多学
shots.scene: 台阶上方的高处亮着警示灯
shots.prompt_en: A higher step on a staircase lit by a warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 风险越高，安全员需要的本领越多。

shots.scene: 王老师在灯下看书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reads a book under a desk lamp in the evening.
shots.narration: 安全员也要持续学习。

shots.scene: 书本叠成台阶，一个人形往上走
shots.prompt_en: Books stacked like stairs with a person icon climbing up. No people.
shots.narration: 知识更新了，自己也要跟上。

shots.scene: 王老师在电脑前写空白文件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator types a blank document on a computer.
shots.narration: 动手写一写：本单位的安全政策。

shots.scene: 安全手册翻开，“职责”一章空白，正在填写
shots.prompt_en: A safety manual opens to a blank chapter with a person icon being filled in. No people.
shots.narration: 再把安全员的职责写进安全手册。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 六个支柱撑起一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Six pillars holding up a large shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全员能不能发挥作用，靠这些：
overlay: 安全员靠什么发挥作用

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 校领导图标给王老师竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: A manager icon with a tie gives a thumbs up to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 领导支持，是第一条。

shots.section_title: 安全员靠什么发挥作用
shots.scene: 工程控制与防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon next to gloves and goggles icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还要懂工程控制和防护用品。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现文化、合规、责任三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a heart, a rule book and a shield.
shots.narration: 安全文化、主动合规、敢担责任。

shots.scene: 王老师被一圈职责图标环绕
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands surrounded by a ring of small duty icons.
shots.narration: 安全员职责多，从评估到培训。

shots.scene: 空白政策文件和翻开的安全手册
shots.prompt_en: A blank policy document next to an open safety manual. No people.
shots.narration: 动手写政策，把职责写进手册。

shots.scene: 阿杰主动填写表格，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank form willingly and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 安全不只是安全员的事。

shots.scene: 欣欣、王老师和阿杰站在实验室门口一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the safety administrator and the young male student stand at a laboratory door and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 人人懂安全，实验才安心，再见！
